name: Sheraton Bali Kuta Resort
positioning: Resort just across from Kuta Beach in Bali, with an infinity pool overlooking the Indian Ocean, balconied rooms and family facilities
best_for: Families wanting family suites, a supervised kids club and shared family activities
Travelers who want a Kuta Beach base a short walk from the Beachwalk shopping mall

facts.text: The resort is situated just across from Kuta Beach.
The Beachwalk shopping mall is a short walk from the resort.
Accommodations start at over 46 square meters.
The Family Suite has a separate master bedroom and a living area with a sofa bed.
The Premium Family Suite sleeps up to five.
Bene Italian Kitchen spans three floors, with poolside terrace seating, a private dining area and an open-air rooftop.
The resort has a spa, Shine Spa for Sheraton.
PlayHouse Kids Club has supervised indoor play areas, interactive games and arts and crafts stations.
Besides the main pool, the resort has a kids' club pool and a children's pool.
Families can join a sunset picnic in the courtyard and make their own sunset-inspired mocktails.
The resort offers a private tour to Uluwatu Temple and a Kecak dance.

highlights.text: The outdoor infinity pool has a sundeck overlooking the Indian Ocean.
The Presidential Suite has a private sundeck and plunge pool.
Side by Side is the resort's family program of activities that children, parents, grandparents and couples can do together.
Sundowner Rooftop serves cocktails with sunset views.

considerations.text: Kuta is the center of tourism in Bali, with markets, bars, local restaurants and vibrant nightlife.
Bali's I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport is about 5 kilometers from the resort.
WhataHotel notes the busy Kuta area can be crowded and noisy.
